nodes.label: Hero product cutaway render
nodes.description: High-quality 3D technical hero shot of a window/door frame corner cutaway on a solid black background, used as marketing or product-landing imagery.

nodes.label: Window frame profile
nodes.description: Corner section of a modern high-performance fenestration frame shown in isometric three-quarter cutaway, revealing internal engineering.

nodes.label: Dark wood-grain exterior finish
nodes.description: Outer frame surfaces display a detailed dark brown wood-grain texture suggesting laminate or foil cladding.

nodes.label: Multi-chamber internal profile
nodes.description: Cross-section exposes a complex multi-chambered internal architecture typical of insulated PVC or composite frames.

nodes.label: Orange hollow rectangular inserts
nodes.description: Bright orange hollow rectangular components seated in two of the largest internal chambers.

nodes.label: Thermal break or structural reinforcement
nodes.description: Orange inserts are inferred as thermal breaks and/or structural reinforcements for heat resistance and frame stability.

nodes.label: Multi-pane glazing unit
nodes.description: Corner of a multi-pane glass unit, at least double-glazed, with a greyish tint held in the frame.

nodes.label: Black seals/gaskets
nodes.description: Black sealing elements at glass-to-frame contact points, consistent with EPDM or similar gasket materials.

nodes.label: Solid black product backdrop
nodes.description: Object isolated on solid black background to emphasize form, texture, and engineering detail as a hero product shot.

nodes.label: Isometric cutaway composition
nodes.description: Viewing angle is isometric three-quarter looking down into the top-corner cutaway; sharp lighting emphasizes wood grain and glossy internals.

nodes.label: Thermal performance product messaging
nodes.description: Cutaway of chambers, inserts, and multi-pane glass is intended to communicate insulation quality and engineered fenestration performance.

nodes.label: PVC or composite frame material
nodes.description: Multi-chamber profile with foil-like wood grain is characteristic of PVC or composite window systems rather than solid wood.
